```{r}
Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_PYTHON = file.path(Sys.getenv('CONDA_ENVS', path.expand('~/miniconda3/envs')), 'torch/bin/python'))
source('../library.R')
source('../source.R')
# every dataset gets its own folder with the same file names, read by 04 and 05:
# data/<dataset>/02_human_annotated, 02_mouse_annotated, 03_concatenated_data (.rds + .h5ad)
for (d in c('full_mouse', 'dissected_mouse'))
  dir.create(file.path('data', d), showWarnings = FALSE)
# the 02 PCA/UMAP of the species objects are not used here (03 makes its own) and break gene / cell renames
drop_reductions = function(obj) { for (r in Reductions(obj)) obj[[r]] = NULL; obj }
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds') |> drop_reductions()
human = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_human_annotated.rds') |> drop_reductions()
homology_tbl = read.csv('../homology_tbl.csv')

ids = coalesce(human[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$ensembl_gene_id,
               human[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$gene_name)

rownames(human) = ids

options(future.globals.maxSize = 20 * 1024^3)  # 20 GiB
rownames(mouse[['MERFISH']]) = coalesce(mouse[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene,
                           mouse[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$gene_name)

concat = concatenate(human, mouse, homology_tbl,
                     tech_human = 'MERFISH', tech_mouse = 'MERFISH')
VariableFeatures(concat) = rownames(concat)
concat = JoinLayers(concat)
concat$nCount_MERFISH = colSums(x = concat[['MERFISH']]$counts)
concat = concat |> 
  subset(nCount_MERFISH > 0) |> 
  RunPCA(npcs = min(50, nrow(concat) - 1)) |>     # PCA + UMAP of the unintegrated data, used by the figures
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)

mouse = RenameCells(mouse, new.names = paste0("mmusculus_", colnames(mouse)))

human = RenameCells(human, new.names = paste0("hsapiens_", colnames(human)))

mouse_keep_cells = intersect(colnames(concat), 
                             colnames(mouse))
human_keep_cells = intersect(colnames(concat),
                             colnames(human))

mouse = mouse[,mouse_keep_cells]
human = human[,human_keep_cells]

# full mouse dataset (written outside data/02_annotated_data, so the 02 inputs are never overwritten)
SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/full_mouse/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
SaveSeuratRds(human, 'data/full_mouse/02_human_annotated.rds')

as.anndata(mouse, file_path = 'data/full_mouse/', 
           file_name = '02_mouse_annotated.h5ad', assay = 'MERFISH', 
           main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'), mode = 'w')
as.anndata(human, file_path = 'data/full_mouse/', 
           file_name = '02_human_annotated.h5ad', assay = 'MERFISH', 
           main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'), mode = 'w')

SaveSeuratRds(concat, 'data/full_mouse/03_concatenated_data.rds')
as.anndata(concat, file_path = 'data/full_mouse/', file_name = '03_concatenated_data.h5ad', 
           assay = 'MERFISH', main_layer = 'counts', 
           other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
```

```{r}
concat = readRDS('data/full_mouse/03_concatenated_data.rds')
concat = concat |> JoinLayers(assay = 'MERFISH')
concat = concat |> 
  RunPCA(reduction.name = 'pca_raw') |> 
  RunUMAP(reduction = 'pca_raw',
          dims = 1:20, reduction.name = 'umap_raw')   # plots only: no UMAP model or neighbour graph needed

concat$celltype = concat$celltype |> as.factor()

DimPlot(concat, reduction = 'umap_raw', group.by = 'celltype',
        shuffle = TRUE)
DimPlot(concat, reduction = 'umap_raw', group.by = 'orig.ident',
        shuffle = TRUE)

DimPlot(concat, reduction = 'pca_raw', group.by = 'celltype',
        shuffle = TRUE)
DimPlot(concat, reduction = 'pca_raw', group.by = 'orig.ident',
        shuffle = TRUE)
```

```{r}
p = plot_ly(
  coords,
  x = ~x,
  y = ~y,
  color = ~celltype,
  type = "scattergl",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 3),
  text = ~paste0(
    "x: ", x,
    "<br>y: ", y
  ),
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
) |>
  layout(
    dragmode = "drawclosedpath",
    newshape = list(line = list(width = 2))
  ) |>
  config(
    modeBarButtonsToAdd = c(
      "drawclosedpath",
      "eraseshape"
    )
  )

p
```

```{r}
# dissected mouse = central tumour block (../EBCC_PIPELINE.md section 5b): the human sample is a breast tumour
# TMA core, so the matching mouse compartment is the tumour mass; this rectangle stays inside it and leaves out
# the normal mammary gland, fat and lymph-node-like tissue at low x and the capsule rim at the edges
# (map: ../figures/breast_cancer/spatial/mouse_dissection_map_*.png). Previous cut: 8560-11745 x 920-5455.
# GetTissueCoordinates units; in ImageDimPlot y is the horizontal and x the vertical axis.
xmin = 4500; xmax = 8500
ymin = 1500; ymax = 5500

ggplot(coords, aes(x, y, color = celltype)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.005) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
           fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
```

```{r}
coords$keep = coords$x >= xmin &
  coords$x <= xmax & 
  coords$y >= ymin &
  coords$y <= ymax

mouse_subset = mouse |> 
  subset(cells = coords$cell[coords$keep])

mouse_subset = mouse_subset |> 
  RunPCA(features = rownames(mouse_subset),
         reduction.name = 'pca_raw') |> 
  RunUMAP(reduction = 'pca_raw',
          dims = 1:20, reduction.name = 'umap_raw')
SaveSeuratRds(mouse_subset, 'data/03_mouse_subset.rds')
as.anndata(mouse_subset, file_path = 'data/',
           file_name = '03_mouse_subset.h5ad', assay = 'MERFISH',
           main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
```

```{r}
source('../library.R')
source('../source.R')
homology_tbl = read.csv('../homology_tbl.csv')
# remove 20/40/60/80% of the shared genes from the dissected dataset (saved to genes2/4/6/8;
# genes8 = 80% removed). Removal is nested: one random order of the shared genes, each level
# drops a longer prefix. Each species is renormalised on the genes that remain, then
# concatenated again (as in bone_marrow, see ../EBCC_PIPELINE.md section 6).
# the 02 PCA/UMAP of the species objects are not used here (03 makes its own) and break gene / cell renames
drop_reductions = function(obj) { for (r in Reductions(obj)) obj[[r]] = NULL; obj }
human = readRDS('data/dissected_mouse/02_human_annotated.rds') |> drop_reductions()
mouse = readRDS('data/dissected_mouse/02_mouse_annotated.rds') |> drop_reductions()
rownames(human) = coalesce(human[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$ensembl_gene_id,
                           human[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$gene_name)
rownames(mouse) = coalesce(mouse[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene,
                           mouse[['MERFISH']]@meta.data$gene_name)
shared_genes = readRDS('data/dissected_mouse/03_concatenated_data.rds')[['MERFISH']]@meta.data
set.seed(1)
removal_order = sample(nrow(shared_genes))

# counts are unchanged; data/scale.data are recomputed on the genes that remain
renormalize = function(obj) {
  obj$nCount_MERFISH = colSums(x = obj[['MERFISH']]$counts)
  obj = obj |>
    subset(nCount_MERFISH > 0)
  VariableFeatures(obj) = rownames(obj)
  obj |>
    NormalizeData() |>
    ScaleData()
}

# species objects carry the hsapiens_/mmusculus_ prefixes; concatenate() adds them itself
make_concat = function(human, mouse) {
  human = RenameCells(human, new.names = sub('^hsapiens_', '', colnames(human)))
  mouse = RenameCells(mouse, new.names = sub('^mmusculus_', '', colnames(mouse)))
  concat = concatenate(human, mouse, homology_tbl, tech_human = 'MERFISH', tech_mouse = 'MERFISH')
  VariableFeatures(concat) = rownames(concat)
  concat = JoinLayers(concat)
  concat$nCount_MERFISH = colSums(x = concat[['MERFISH']]$counts)
  concat = concat |>
    subset(nCount_MERFISH > 0)
  # PCA + UMAP of the unintegrated data, used by the figures
  concat |>
    RunPCA(npcs = min(50, nrow(concat) - 1)) |>
    RunUMAP(dims = 1:20)
}

save_dataset = function(x, out) {
  dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE)
  SaveSeuratRds(x$mouse, file.path(out, '02_mouse_annotated.rds'))
  SaveSeuratRds(x$human, file.path(out, '02_human_annotated.rds'))
  SaveSeuratRds(x$concat, file.path(out, '03_concatenated_data.rds'))
  as.anndata(x$mouse, file_path = paste0(out, '/'), file_name = '02_mouse_annotated.h5ad', assay = 'MERFISH',
             main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'), mode = 'w')
  as.anndata(x$human, file_path = paste0(out, '/'), file_name = '02_human_annotated.h5ad', assay = 'MERFISH',
             main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'), mode = 'w')
  as.anndata(x$concat, file_path = paste0(out, '/'), file_name = '03_concatenated_data.h5ad', assay = 'MERFISH',
             main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
}

# p = fraction of the shared genes removed
reduce_genes = function(p) {
  out = file.path('data', paste0('genes', round(p * 10)))
  removed = shared_genes[removal_order[seq_len(round(p * nrow(shared_genes)))], ]
  human_p = human[!rownames(human) %in% removed$hsapiens_homolog_ensembl_gene, ] |> renormalize()
  mouse_p = mouse[!rownames(mouse) %in% removed$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene, ] |> renormalize()
  concat_p = make_concat(human_p, mouse_p)
  # species objects keep the cells of the concatenated data, as for full_mouse / dissected_mouse
  human_p = human_p[, intersect(colnames(human_p), colnames(concat_p))]
  mouse_p = mouse_p[, intersect(colnames(mouse_p), colnames(concat_p))]
  print(str_glue('{out}: removed {nrow(removed)} of {nrow(shared_genes)} shared genes, ',
                 '{nrow(concat_p)} remain; {ncol(concat_p)} cells'))
  save_dataset(list(human = human_p, mouse = mouse_p, concat = concat_p), out)
}

for (p in c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)) reduce_genes(p)
```
